我的朋友杰克(My Friend Jack): 围绕节日文化的A1短文:介绍山姆的日常、喜好与年货市场。
Sam and Jack are in the same class. Sam's favorite subject is music. The moon-lit yard is big and clean. In fact, she bought some fruit at the market.
We talk about music a lot. We often go to the museum together. I like my life very much. My rabbit eats cabbage leaves.
Sam likes basketball very much. The spring market is my favorite place. My friend Jack is very kind.
